0022600099.text: The Milwaukee Bucks host the Chicago Bulls in the Bucks' second game of the 2026-27 season, and both teams are 0-1 after one game. The Bucks are 13th in the East and 4th in the Central, one game back, while the Bulls are 15th in the East and 5th in the Central, also one game back. Milwaukee won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, but the Bucks lost their most recent meeting 120-97 in Chicago on March 1, 2026. Chicago's Nic Claxton is out with a hamstring injury, and Dailyn Swain, Jordan Hawkins, Josh Giddey, Tobe Awaka and Zach Collins are listed as day-to-day with gametime decisions, with Swain and Hawkins dealing with illness, Giddey with a wrist injury, Awaka with a knee sprain and Collins with a quadriceps injury.
